correctness.rationale: Chebyshev determinant identity det(z-H)=2J^n[T_n(z/2J)-cos(phi)+i gamma/(4J) U_{n-1}(z/2J)] makes each half-flux dark root simple in the lossy characteristic polynomial. Expansion of cos(pi+delta) and U derivative gives -Im z=4J^2 sin^2(theta)delta^2/(gamma n)+O(delta^4). Dark spectral projectors are orthogonal at delta=0, while other modes decay uniformly on the delta^-2 scale for fixed n, giving the finite mixture. A subsequent midpoint integral yields exp(-tau/2)I0(tau/2) and 1/sqrt(pi tau). Independently evaluated small-ring non-Hermitian matrices for n=4,6,8 and delta=0.002; widths matched within 0.5%. No joint n,delta limit is asserted.
